name: Glow Keyboard
description: Dark illustrated keyboard whose keys glow in random colors from a seasonal palette, with keys that press down on hover.
contents: Five-row keyboard layout with glowing key labels
behavior: Each key gets a random color from the chosen palette on mount
Everything scales with the container width
editableByProps: Glow strength of text and key boxes
fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Key colors are picked randomly on the client after mount, so the root renders empty first
Key text is tiny on 360px screens because everything scales with the keyboard width
